title: Recreating The Curse of Monkey Island in HD (Browser Point & Click Engine Demo)
author: bbxtudios
selftext:
Hello everyone! I'm excited to share that I'm currently developing a point-and-click game engine and studio that runs directly in the browser and is completely free to use.

To test its potential, I wanted to do something fun: I recreated 4 scenes in HD as a parody/tribute to *The Curse of Monkey Island*, always with the utmost respect for the original creators. *Monkey Island* has always been my favorite point-and-click adventure of all time, and I wanted to see how far the engine could go.

⚠️ **Important note:** This is strictly a **proof of concept**. I will not be sharing the playable project or continuing its development due to copyright reasons; I simply built it to push the technical limits of the engine.

I'm leaving the YouTube video below. Some animations didn't turn out quite right, but the visual upgrade is definitely noticeable. I really hope they decide to make an official HD remaster of this masterpiece someday!

📢 **Soon I will make a separate post officially announcing the engine with all the details, and I'll link it right here.**

Hope you enjoy the quick showcase, and I'd love to hear your thoughts!

👉 [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mpqXr7qh4z4**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mpqXr7qh4z4)
